messages:
maria: Quick triage — I pulled ArgoLite-35b into the intake queue. Can we do a lightweight prioritization now? TL;DR: candidate looks promising on dev perf but we need a fast smoke for quant and a small eval sweep for regressions.

dan: I can take a look at perf baselines; will run a few 1k-token latency runs. ETA end of day.

kai: I can run a 4-bit quant smoke tonight. If it passes, we can include cost delta in the score.

sasha: I can do a short eval set (summarization + safety probes) — would prefer a focused prompt set rather than full suite.

eva: FYI we've been seeing some recent regression noise on similar arch models; if evalbot flags anything major let's hold.

evalbot: regression-checker: New regression signal for summarization rouge: -3.4 on short-prompts-v2. Details: https://internal/evals/2481234567 (auto).

maria: @evalbot thanks — that link looks noisy but worth validating. Kai/sasha can you prioritize the short-prompts-v2 set? Keep it to ~150 examples.

kai: Yep — I'll run quant smoke + quick bleu/rouge on short-prompts-v2. Command I'll use: 
```bash
python infra/quant_smoke.py \
  --model argo-lite-35b \
  --bits 4 \
  --batch 1 \
  --prompt-file eval_sets/short-prompts-v2.json \
  --output /tmp/argo4b-smoke.json
```
I'll also capture perf via `tools/latency_profiler --target argo-lite-35b`.

sasha: Running eval set now. Using the reduced safety suite + summarization. Will post top 5 failures.

dan: Perf baseline: running `wrk` style synthetic now, then I'll run a couple of real chat traces from production to compare.

maria: Scoring rubric proposal (quick):
- Production impact (0-5) — how many customers use impacted flow
- Latency delta (0-5) — quantized vs fp16
- Quality delta (0-10) — eval regression severity
- Operational risk (0-3) — memory, KV stability
We weight Quality x2, Latency x1, ProdImpact x1, Risk penalty. Thoughts?

eva: Fine with weights. Make sure to log the exact eval commit used (git hash) so we can reproduce.

kai: Found one weird output in the smoke — short hallucination case. Will add to failures.

sasha: Eval results (short): 150 prompts -> rouge avg -2.9, 7 flagged safety cases, 5 hallucinations that differ from fp16. Attaching top diffs.

maria: OK sounds like we need a small mitigations pass before greenlighting. Action items:
- kai: run a 2x rerun with different quant config (qfun=per-channel) and attach perf numbers (due tonight).
- sasha: curate top 10 failures and annotate severity (low/med/high) (due EOD).
- dan: capture 95/99 p50 latency baselines and p99 for fp16 vs 4-bit (due EOD).
- eva: prepare a quick note on customer impact surface for the summarization flows (tomorrow morning).

maria: If all three (perf, quant config, eval) look OK we slot ArgoLite into next week's bring-up queue as a medium priority. If either quality regressions are high we punt and open a bug.

dan: Acked. I'll put perf numbers into the intake board and tag with #prio-medium.

kai: Starting quant runs now. Will ping here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sasha: Sending annotated failures in 45m.

eva: I'll prep the impact note.

maria: Thanks everyone — quick sync tomorrow 10:00 PT if we have results. Otherwise we'll reconvene after EOD updates. :thumbsup:
